name: Governance Permission Gate
description: Runs deny-list + phase-gate + egress checks before tool execution. Blocks if permission.py returns exit 2.
_fix_note: G-BA-002: previously sent tool_input:{} so deny/egress could not inspect the command. Now forwards the tool payload. Kiro variable syntax varies by runtime version — VERIFY in a real Kiro session that {{tool_name}}/{{tool_input}} expand to the actual call before relying on this as enforcement.
